title: Quiz engine with topics and results
prompt:
Build a quiz engine in Python as a package quiz/ with quiz/__init__.py, quiz/bank.py and quiz/session.py.
- quiz/bank.py: load_questions(path) reads a JSON list of {"q": text, "choices": [at least 2 strings], "answer": index of the right choice, "topic": text} and returns it as a list of dicts. A question with fewer than 2 choices, an answer index out of range, or a missing key raises ValueError naming the question number (starting at 1).
- quiz/session.py: class QuizSession(questions, seed=0, count=None). The order is: qs = list(questions); random.Random(seed).shuffle(qs); then only the first count (all if None). current() -> the current question dict, or None when finished. answer(index) -> True or False and moves to the next question; answering when finished raises RuntimeError. finished -> bool property. score -> number right. results() -> {"score": n, "total": number of questions in this session, "percent": rounded to 1 decimal, "by_topic": {topic: [right, asked]}, "missed": [the q text of each wrong answer, in order]}.
Write unit tests too.
